system.description:
Required Weapon: Sabre & Dagger The Sabat school of fencing favors a defensive Style that allows opponents to attack tirelessly to exhaust themselves.

  • Keen Insight. During a combat scene, you may spend any amount of Hope to discern how your target fights. For each Hope spent, gain a +1 bonus to your rolls against the target. The bonus lasts until you fail or attack someone else.
  • The Gambit. Waiting for the perfect strike, you may mark a Stress to roll a d20 as your Hope die for your next attack. If it succeeds, the attack deals an additional 1d8 damage.
  • Practiced Precautions. You add your Wits to your Evasion.
